answer_1.quote: Data-to-text (D2T) generation aims to generate a natural language description conditioned on structured or semi-structured data, such as graphs or tables.
answer_1.outputs: natural language description (response) summarizing the SQL query and its result table

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we employ the widely used metric, BLEU and ROUGE-L, to evaluate the fluency of generated text. And we utilize SacreBLEU to calculate the BLEU after segmenting the sentence by jieba. Additionally, we utilize COVERAGE to evaluate the faithfulness of generated text.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation following Parikh et al. ... five native Chinese annotators ... evaluate the quality from the four axes. Specifically, FLUENCY measures whether the description is fluent. FAITHFULNESS estimates whether the description is logically consistent with input SQL, and all pieces of information are supported by the input table.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated description on multiple criteria: Fluency, Faithfulness, Coverage, and Repetition.
